headline: HALF My BUSINESS is GONE! Trade War CHAOS 😱🔥
text:
BUSINESS 🏪 OWNERS 🧑‍💼 in CANADA 🇨🇦 and the US 🇺🇸 are NAVIGATING 🧭 UNCERTAINTY 😵‍💫 as TIT-FOR-TAT 🍒 import taxes 📈 INCREASE 🔥 after TRADE 🤝 TALKS 💼 between the two countries 🌍 COLLAPSED 🥀 over the WEEKEND 🗓️!! CindyLouWhoa 🍑 Cindy Baldassi relies on AMERICAN 🦅 buyers 🛍️ for her stone 🪨 and glass 🪟 jewellery 💎 company 🏬 CindyLouWho2 based in Calgary 🏔️ Alberta with 75% of sales 💰 from AMERICANS 🇺🇸. With a majority 👥 of items falling under the new 50% tariffs 🛡️ she will need to add 50% ➕ to the price 🏷️ of most products 📦 to stay afloat 🛟. She told the BBC 📻 "It's quite likely 🤔 that it will wipe out 🌪️ most of my US sales 💸. I expect that at least half ✂️ of my business 🏪 will be gone 💨" and damn this TRADE WAR ⚔️ has her DOWN BAD 🥺 after getting RAILED 💦💦 by the CHAOS 😵 no cap 🧢 fr fr 💯!!

CANADIAN 🍁 PRIME 🏛️ MINISTER 👔 Mark 🧔 Carney 🇨🇦 has PLEDGED 💦 some LEVIES 💰 STARTING 🏁 on 8 SEPTEMBER 🗓️ targeting 🎯 US 🦅 STEEL 🏗️ , DAIRY 🥛 , APPLIANCES 🛠️ and ELECTRONICS 📱 after Trump tariffs 💥 went 🏃 into effect on SATURDAY 🗓️ hitting 🥊 Canadian 🍁 WINE 🍷 , DAIRY 🥛 , CEMENT 🧱 , CLOTHING 👕 and HOCKEY 🏒 EQUIPMENT 🏑 . The US tariffs apply to about 20bn 💰 of Canadian 🍁 EXPORTS 🛳️ to the US 🇺🇸 - about 5% 📉 of annual shipments 📦 - and they ADD ➕ to existing tariffs on steel 🏗️ , aluminium 🪙 , autos 🚗 and lumber 🪵 leaving Canada 🇨🇦 very exposed 😬 if the import taxes MULTIPLY ✖️ because 70% 📈 of its exports 🛳️ are to the US 🇺🇸 leaving HALF the BUSINESS 💼 GONE 💨 in this TRADE 🥊 WAR CHAOS 😱🔥 and it's like Canada is getting THOROUGHLY RAILED 💦 with this back and forth no cap fr fr 🥵!!

LIND 🛋️ FURNITURE 🪑 has 🖐️ been 🕒 in the BUSINESS 🏬 for almost 60 🗓️ years 🕰️ in ONTARIO 🗺️ but SALES 📉 DROPPED 📉 when TRUMP 🍊 took 🏛️ OFFICE 🏛️ in 2025 🗓️ as people 👥 put their purchases 🛍️ on hold 🛑 when there were tariffs 🌋 in the air ☁️!! MICHAEL 🧔 SAIFER the GENITAL 🫀 MANAGER 🧑‍💼 told 📢 the BBC 📰 that everyone 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 wants to sell 💸 to the AMERICANS 🦅 because they can buy 🛒 from whoever 🧑 they want and he added 'I don't know that we're going to win a war with them; we may get killed' 💀 which is basically the INDUSTRY 🏭 getting RAILED 💦💦 by this TRADE WAR ⚔️ no cap 🧢 the CANADIAN 🇨🇦 ECONOMY is looking COOKED 🍳 and DOWN BAD 🥴 fr fr 💯!!

listen 😱 up this toronto 🏙️ based 🏠 menswear 🍆 brand 🏷️ called 🗣️ OUTCLASS 🧥 founder 🧔 MATTEO 🕴️ SGARAMELLA 🧑‍💼 collects 📥 orders 📦 from 👕 clothing 👚 designers 🧵 months 🗓️ before ⏳ they are due 📅 to arrive 🚚 in the stores 🛍️ and now ⏰ the products 📦 that US 🇺🇸 stores 🏬 ordered 📋 in JANUARY ❄️ will be arriving 🚛 in SEPTEMBER 🍂 but with a new 🆕 TARIFF 📈 attached 🔗 so if he contacts 📞 them about an extra ➕ 50% bill 💵 from UPS 📬 theyre all 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 going to say 🗣️ NO WAY 🚫 dont 🙅 ship 📦 it 🚢 he noted 📝 only 20% of his wholesale 🏪 sales 💰 and 20% of his E-CUMMERCE 💦 come from the US 🇺🇸 but added THERES GOING TO BE A LOT of people 👥 that go out of business 🏚️ BECAUSE OF THIS 🔥 and that SMALL BUSINESSES 🏬 are going to get SMASHED 💥 by this 🍑💦!!

FOR 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Mike 🧔 Roach 🐓 AND 👫 Kim 👩 Osgood 👠 OWNERS 🏪 OF 📍 Paloma 🐦 Clothing 👕 IN 🌆 Portland 🏞️ Oregon 🌲 the tariffs 📜 MEAN 🧠 preparing 🛠️ for ONE 1️⃣ of their BESTSELLING 🏅 items 🛍️ to INCREASE 📈 in price 💲 Osgood 👩‍🎨 CREATES 🖌️ designs that a Montreal 🏒 CUMpany 🏭 TRANSFERS 🚚 onto pillows 🛏️ retailing at $59 💵 with the newly imposed tariffs 📜 a normal markup 🏷️ would bring the price 📉 to between $86 😬 AND 😤 $90 😱 the couple 👫 whose shop 🏬 has been operating for 51 🥇 years 🗓️ say they will likely HOLD 🛑 the original price 💰 and hope 🤞 the tariff problem 🌀 gets worked 🫦 out Roach 🗣️ SAID 💬 gift 🎁 items 🧸 are really price-point sensitive 📍 and that it would be one thing if they had three months 📅 notice 📋 but when it happens overnight 🌙 youre really STUCK 🪤 this trade war 🔥 has their BUSINESS 💼 getting POUNDED 💦 overnight 😳 no cap 🧢 fr fr 💯!!

TRADE 💼 WAR 🔥 CHAOS 🌪️ has left BILL 🧔 EASTON 🍷 OWNER 🏅 of Terre 🏡 Rouge 🍷 Wines 🍾 UNABLE 🙅 to SHIP 🚢 his precious WINE 🍷 to Canada 🇨🇦 for the PAST 🕵️ YEAR 📅 AND A HALF 1️⃣🕐 due to the BOYCOTT 🛑 and he's PAYING 💰 $2400 🤑 every MONTH 🗓️ to STORE 🏬 it as the WINE 🥃 has just GOTTEN 🆙 BETTER 🏆 in the WAREHOUSE 🏭 but he can't expect his Canadian CUMSTOMER 🛍️ to pay extra cost he told BBC 📺!! Heather Seevers' 🧶 Northwest Yarns 🧵 shop in Bellingham Washington 25 ⏱️ MINUTES from BORDER 🛂 saw Canadian CUSTOMERS 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 drop 20% 📉 since TARIFF 📋 WAR ⚔️ began getting EMAILS ✉️ saying they could not PATRONIZE 🛍️ her BUSINESS 🏪 due to ANTI 🇨🇦 RHETORIC 🗣️ so shop LAUNCHED 🚀 FUNDRAISING 🏦 INITIATIVE to stay AFLOAT 🛟. She said it's going to get WORSE 😟 before it gets BETTER 🌈 and will take YEARS 🗓️ and YEARS 🗓️ to get RELATIONSHIP 🤝 back with Canada!! This has HALF ✂️ her BUSINESS 💼 GONE 🕳️ leaving them all RAILED 💦 by the madness 😵 fr fr 💯😱!!
